Recruitment Overview

The Supreme Court of India invites applications for 90 Law Clerk positions in New Delhi. The online application process began on January 20, 2026, and will close on February 7, 2026. Eligible candidates must be between 20 and 32 years old as of February 7, 2026. This unique opportunity offers a chance to work with India's apex court. Interested applicants should review the official notification for Supreme Court Law Clerk Recruitment 2026 to ensure they meet the required criteria and submit their applications before the deadline. Apply now to be part of the nation's judicial system.
